stem: A forest has 9,000 pine trees. Researchers examined a random sample of 120 of the trees and found that 21 of them were infected with a fungus. The margin of error for the estimated percent of infected trees is 7 percentage points. Based on these results, what is the least plausible number of infected pine trees in the forest?
verify:
p = Rational(21, 120)
lo = (p - Rational(7, 100)) * 9000
assert lo == 945
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [lo]
